statement.en: Offer to add a new pass to Wallet when an action creates one.
statement.ja: actionによってnew passが作成されたときWalletへの追加を提案する。

conditions: Use one-tap system UI by default.
Background addition is available for frequent, predictable actions after one-time authorization.
Offer a review-first custom view when appropriate.

statement.en: Offer to add a new pass to Wallet when a person's action creates one.
statement.ja: ユーザーの操作によって新しいパスが作成されたら、Walletへの追加を提案する。

conditions: A one-tap system interface can offer addition.
For frequent, predictable actions, background addition is an option after one-time authorization.
If the person wants to review the pass first, a custom review view can provide an Add to Apple Wallet button.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 4: preserve optional presentation choices and prior authorization; remove the unsupported default. User choice precedes generic platform guidance.

statement.en: Apply the documented Wallet guidance to help people add a pass created outside your app.
statement.ja: 「Wallet」において「Help people add a pass created outside your app」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Suggest the pass when it was created on the website or another device.
The separate declined-suggestion rule protects a person's choice.

statement.en: Help people add a pass created outside your app to Wallet.
statement.ja: アプリ外で作成したパスをWalletに追加できるようにする。

conditions: For a pass created on a website or another device, suggest adding it when the person next opens the app.
If the person declines that suggestion, do not ask again for the same pass.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 6: restore the concrete next-opening context and source-backed decline boundary, replacing internal rule references.

statement.en: Present an Add to Apple Wallet button to let people add an existing pass not already in Wallet in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況でan Add to Apple Wallet button to let people add an existing pass not already in Walletを表示する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Show an Add to Apple Wallet button for an existing pass that is not already in Wallet.
statement.ja: 既存のパスがまだWalletにない場合は、「Add to Apple Wallet」ボタンを表示する。

conditions: A person who previously declined or removed a pass can change their mind and use the button.
The button can appear where the app displays information about the pass; its availability is not a repeated unsolicited suggestion.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 10: retain an available user-initiated addition path, distinct from repeating a declined suggestion.

statement.en: Preserve people’s ability to jump from your app to their pass in Wallet.
statement.ja: 利用者がjump from your app to their pass in Walletできる状態を保つ。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Let people open a pass in Wallet directly from your app.
statement.ja: アプリからWallet内のパスを直接開けるようにする。

conditions: Where the app shows information about a pass already in Wallet, it can offer a direct link to that pass.
Use a label that conveys the destination; View in Wallet is an example, not mandatory wording.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 12: preserve the optional direct-link presentation and illustrative label.

statement.en: Always get a person's permission before deleting passes from Wallet.
statement.ja: Walletからpassを削除する前に必ず本人のpermissionを得る。

conditions: An app setting can let people choose manual deletion or authorize automatic removal.
Show an alert before deletion when necessary.

statement.en: Always get permission before deleting a pass from Wallet.
statement.ja: Walletからパスを削除する前に、必ずユーザーの許可を得る。

conditions: An in-app setting can let the person choose manual deletion or authorize automatic deletion.
An alert is another option when needed; the source does not require both a setting and an alert, or a new alert after valid prior authorization.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 16 explicitly requires permission. Preserve MUST, while treating settings and necessary alerts as permission mechanisms rather than cumulative requirements.

statement.en: Apply the documented Wallet guidance to help the system suggest a pass when relevant.
statement.ja: 「Wallet」において「Help the system suggest a pass when relevant」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Provide relevance information so the system can suggest a pass when people are likely to need it.
statement.ja: 必要になりそうなときにシステムがパスを提示できるよう、関連する日時や場所の情報を提供する。

conditions: Supply information about when and where the pass is relevant.
The system can use that information for suggestions such as a Lock Screen link; eligible pass types can also appear in a Live Activity.
These are system presentation possibilities, not a guarantee of display or a requirement to implement a custom Live Activity.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 18: distinguish relevance metadata guidance from system surfacing capabilities.

statement.en: Maintain passes up to date.
statement.ja: passes up to dateを維持する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Keep passes up to date as their information changes.
statement.ja: 情報が変わったらパスを更新し、最新の状態に保つ。

conditions: Update relevant changes such as a flight delay or a new gate.
Updating pass content does not mean every change needs an interrupting change message.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 24: direct bilingual wording; examples remain illustrative and change messages remain separately constrained by row 26.

statement.en: Use a Wallet change message only for information people need to know promptly.
statement.ja: Wallet change messageは利用者がpromptly知る必要があるinformationにだけ使う。

conditions: A change message interrupts people.
The separate prohibition excludes marketing and other noncritical communication.

statement.en: Use pass change messages only for time-critical information that people need to know.
statement.ja: パスの変更メッセージは、ユーザーが知る必要のある時間的に重要な情報に限って使用する。

conditions: A change message interrupts the person, so reserve it for urgent, consequential updates such as a changed departure gate.
Routine details, such as a customer-service phone-number change, do not warrant a change message.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Passes row 26: preserve the existing MUST classification for the explicit only restriction on interruptions; remove internal rule-organization language.

statement.en: Apply the documented Wallet guidance to design a pass that looks great and works well on all devices.
statement.ja: 「Wallet」において「Design a pass that looks great and works well on all devices」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Account for Apple Watch showing less information and fewer images than iPhone.
The separate essential-information rule handles unavailable elements.

statement.en: Make sure a pass looks and works well on every device where people use it.
statement.ja: パスを利用する各デバイスで、見やすく適切に機能するようにする。

conditions: Account for differences in available space, information, and images, particularly on Apple Watch.
Do not assume every device displays all the same pass elements.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Designing passes row 50: device constraints, not gaze input. Remove the lexical false-positive gaze tag and internal rule references.

statement.en: Maintain the pass front uncluttered.
statement.ja: the pass front unclutteredを維持する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Keep the front of a pass uncluttered and focused on information people need quickly.
statement.ja: パスの表面は情報を詰め込みすぎず、すぐに確認したい内容に絞る。

conditions: Place essential information in header fields so it remains visible when the pass is collapsed.
Keep other important information easy to find, and place infrequently needed details in the additional-information sheet.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Designing passes row 52: preserve information hierarchy and the collapsed-pass rationale without generic boilerplate.

statement.en: Apply the documented Wallet guidance to make your pass instantly identifiable.
statement.ja: 「Wallet」において「Make your pass instantly identifiable」の指針を適用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Make a pass instantly recognizable as belonging to your organization or service.
statement.ja: どの組織やサービスのパスか、ひと目で分かるようにする。

conditions: Brand colors, images, icons, and full-art backgrounds are possible ways to establish recognition; the source does not require every technique.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Designing passes row 54: retain recognizability as the objective, with branding methods as examples.

statement.en: Ensure Wallet pass text has sufficient contrast against solid and image backgrounds.
statement.ja: Wallet pass textがsolidおよびimage backgroundに対して十分なcontrastを持つようにする。

conditions: Choose label colors that remain legible over solid backgrounds and images.
For strip images, keep text legible over the image.

statement.en: Ensure sufficient contrast between pass text and its background.
statement.ja: パスの文字と背景の間に十分なコントラストを確保する。

conditions: Check labels against both solid-color backgrounds and background images.
Text over a strip image also needs sufficient contrast.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Designing passes row 56 and Strip image row 175 support legibility across both background forms. Preserve MUST; accessibility has priority over platform-common styling.

statement.en: Choose or apply language that works on any device in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではlanguage that works on any deviceを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

statement.en: Use pass language that makes sense on every device where the pass appears.
statement.ja: パスを表示するどのデバイスでも意味が通じる表現を使う。

conditions: Avoid instructions that assume an interaction available only on one device, such as an iPhone sliding instruction that does not fit Apple Watch.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Designing passes row 66: device-appropriate instructions, not a requirement to use a particular gesture or add an input-modality tag.

statement.en: Maintain image file sizes small.
statement.ja: image file sizes smallを維持する。

conditions: Use the smallest image files that still look good to speed email and webpage downloads.

statement.en: Keep pass image files small while preserving good visual quality.
statement.ja: 見た目の品質を保ちながら、パス画像のファイルサイズを小さくする。

conditions: Efficient image files help passes download quickly from email and websites.
Balance small file sizes with good visual quality.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Pass images row 91 balances download efficiency with quality; no byte threshold is specified.

statement.en: Make a pass icon available when applicable.
statement.ja: 必要な場合にa pass iconを利用可能にする。

conditions: The system uses the icon on the Lock Screen, in Mail, and on Wallet passes.
Use the app icon or a separately designed icon.

statement.en: Provide an icon for the pass.
statement.ja: パス用のアイコンを用意する。

conditions: The pass icon can reuse the app icon or have a separate design.
The system uses it in contexts such as the Lock Screen, Mail, and the pass; it applies rounded corners automatically.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Pass images row 93 and Icon row 156: remove the unsupported when-applicable qualifier; retain alternative icon designs and automatic corner treatment as capabilities.

statement.en: Exclude inner drop shadows on logo artwork from the applicable experience.
statement.ja: 該当する体験ではinner drop shadows on logo artworkを避ける。

conditions: Inner drop shadows can reduce logo legibility on the pass.

statement.en: Avoid inner drop shadows in pass logos.

conditions: Inner shadows can reduce logo legibility.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Logo row 113: AVOID remains appropriate; the stated reason is legibility, not decorative preference.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Paragraph297 does not qualify multiple contact methods with where-possible; remove the unsupported qualifier while keeping SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0014.review_note: Recorded the download-performance reason and retained SHOULD.

conditions: The system uses the icon on the Lock Screen, in Mail, and on Wallet passes.
Use the app icon or a separately designed icon.
Inner drop shadows can reduce logo legibility on the pass.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0016.review_note: Retained AVOID because the source presents a legibility risk, not an absolute prohibition.

conditions: Provide available data immediately even when payment, processing, or fulfillment is pending.
If details are delayed, explain that people can check back later.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0018.review_note: Recorded the pending-state fallback and retained SHOULD.

conditions: Update fulfillment data and order status as they change.
The system can notify customers from the reported fulfillment status.
Localize order text for all customers.
The separate price rule records the explicit final-price match.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0020.review_note: Kept the writing guidance at SHOULD and separated the financial-accuracy MUST.

conditions: Prefer a universal link so order management works when the app isn't installed.
Wallet notifications can be suppressed when an associated app is installed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0022.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the associated-app condition.

conditions: Offer multiple contact methods where possible.
The separate minimum-contact rule requires a merchant website or landing-page link.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0023.review_note: Kept the multiple-method recommendation separate from the explicit minimum.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0024.title: Provide enough fulfillment information to track an order

statement.en: Provide enough fulfillment information for people to know where their items are and when to expect them.
statement.ja: itemの所在と到着見込みを理解できるだけのfulfillment informationを提供する。

conditions: Apply to both shipping and pickup fulfillments.
Include an estimated arrival time and relevant tracking or pickup information.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0024.review_note: Raised the explicit need-to-supply requirement to MUST and preserved both fulfillment types.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0029.title: Request identity information only when it is needed

statement.en: Request Wallet identity information only at the precise moment the current process requires it.
statement.ja: current processで必要になる正確な時点にだけWallet identity informationを要求する。

conditions: Wait until people are completing the process or transaction that requires verification.
The separate prohibition covers premature and account-creation requests.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0029.review_note: Raised the only restriction to a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0030.title: Request only the identity data the task needs

statement.en: Request only the Wallet identity data needed to complete the current task.
statement.ja: current taskの完了に必要なWallet identity dataだけを要求する。

conditions: For age eligibility, request an age threshold instead of a current age or birth date.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0030.review_note: Raised data minimization to MUST under the repository's privacy priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0032.title: Offer Wallet verification only on supported devices

statement.en: Offer Wallet identity verification only when the current device can return the requested information.
statement.ja: current deviceがrequested informationを返せる場合だけWallet identity verificationを提供する。

conditions: Don't display the Verify with Apple Wallet button when the requested information is unavailable.
The separate fallback rule covers an alternate verification method.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0032.review_note: Raised the only restriction and explicit don't-display condition to a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0033.title: Keep textual pass information out of images

statement.en: Keep textual Wallet pass information in accessible text fields or semantic tags instead of images.
statement.ja: Wallet passのtextual informationをimageではなくaccessible text fieldまたはsemantic tagに置く。

conditions: Embedded text isn't accessible and may disappear on devices that don't show the image.
The separate barcode rule covers machine-readable content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0033.review_note: Raised the accessibility-critical content-placement requirement to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0035.title: Explain why requested identity information is needed

statement.en: Provide clear purpose text that explains why a person needs to share the requested identity information.
statement.ja: requested identity informationを共有する必要性を説明するclearなpurpose textを提供する。

conditions: Write a brief, complete, direct, and specific sentence.
Use sentence case, active voice, and a final period.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0035.review_note: Raised to MUST from the explicit You must purpose-string requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0036.title: Disclose identity-data retention

statement.en: Clearly disclose whether identity data is retained and, when it is, how long it will be kept.
statement.ja: identity dataをretainするかどうかと、retainする場合の期間を明確に開示する。

conditions: Specify a PassKit retention duration so the verification sheet can explain it.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0036.review_note: Raised the privacy disclosure to MUST because the source calls the retention explanation essential.

statement.en: Add related Wallet passes as a group.
statement.ja: related Wallet passをgroupとして追加する。

conditions: Add app-generated passes together.
Bundle website-distributed passes for one download.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0037.review_note: Activated the missed grouping lead and preserved both app and website paths.

statement.en: Tell the system when each Wallet pass expires.
statement.ja: 各Wallet passのexpirationをsystemへ伝える。

conditions: Set the expiration date, relevant date, and voided properties correctly so Wallet can hide expired passes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0038.review_note: Activated the missed expiration lead and recorded every named property.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0039.title: Provide the required Wallet order logo asset

statement.en: Provide a recognizable high-resolution Wallet order logo with the documented format, size, and background.
statement.ja: documented format、size、backgroundを満たすrecognizableなhigh-resolution Wallet order logoを提供する。

conditions: Use PNG or JPEG at 300×300 pixels.
Use a nontransparent background.
Check recognition at dashboard and detail-view sizes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0039.review_note: Classified the exact order-logo asset specification as a platform contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0040.title: Provide required Wallet product image assets

statement.en: Provide distinct high-resolution Wallet product images with the documented format, size, and background.
statement.ja: documented format、size、backgroundを満たすdistinctなhigh-resolution Wallet product imageを提供する。

conditions: Use PNG or JPEG at 300×300 pixels for each product.
Use a solid nontransparent background and a straightforward depiction.
Avoid busy lifestyle contexts that obscure the item at small sizes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0040.review_note: Classified the exact product-asset specification as a platform contract.

conditions: The system can truncate text that is too long.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0041.review_note: Activated the qualified concise-text recommendation without treating it as a hard limit.

conditions: Order installed apps by preferred link priority.
The system uses the first installed app, or the list's first app when none are installed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0042.review_note: Activated the missed app-priority lead and recorded both selection branches.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0043.title: Never repeat a declined pass-add suggestion

statement.en: Never ask again after a person declines a suggestion to add a pass to Wallet.
statement.ja: Walletへのpass追加提案を利用者がdeclineした後は再度尋ねない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0043.review_note: Raised the direct don't instruction to MUST_NOT under explicit user intent.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0044.title: Never use change messages for marketing or noncritical communication

statement.en: Never use a Wallet change message for marketing or other noncritical communication.
statement.ja: Wallet change messageをmarketingやその他のnoncritical communicationに使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0044.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition separately from the time-critical-only requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0045.title: Include required semantic tags in semantic passes

statement.en: Include semantic tags in poster event passes and semantic boarding passes.
statement.ja: poster event passとsemantic boarding passにsemantic tagを含める。

conditions: Semantic tags enable automatic layout for these pass types.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0045.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit required platform contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0046.title: Include legacy pass fields alongside semantic tags

statement.en: Include pass fields alongside semantic tags so semantic passes display on older iOS versions.
statement.ja: semantic passがolder iOSで表示されるようsemantic tagとともにpass fieldを含める。

conditions: Apply to poster event passes and semantic boarding passes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0046.review_note: Recovered the direct compatibility requirement as a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0047.title: Never put essential pass information in device-dependent elements

statement.en: Never place essential pass information in elements that may be unavailable on a supported device.
statement.ja: supported deviceで利用できない可能性があるelementにessential pass informationを置かない。

conditions: Apple Watch can show less information and fewer images than iPhone.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0047.review_note: Raised the cross-device essential-information safeguard to an accessibility MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0048.title: Avoid padding in pass images

statement.en: Avoid adding padding to Wallet pass images.
statement.ja: Wallet pass imageへのpadding追加を避ける。

conditions: watchOS can crop white space from some images.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0048.review_note: Kept the direct avoid guidance at AVOID and recorded the watchOS reason.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0049.title: Use semantic tags for airline boarding passes

statement.en: Use semantic tags to define airline boarding passes.
statement.ja: airline boarding passの定義にsemantic tagを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0049.review_note: Classified the pass-style selection as a Wallet format contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0050.title: Use pass fields for nonairline transit passes

statement.en: Use pass fields to define transit passes other than airline boarding passes.
statement.ja: airline boarding pass以外のtransit passの定義にpass fieldを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0050.review_note: Separated the nonairline branch of the Wallet pass-style contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0051.title: Use documented Wallet pass image assets

statement.en: Create Wallet pass images as PNG assets at @2x and @3x using the documented filenames and dimensions.
statement.ja: Wallet pass imageをdocumented filenameとdimensionの@2x/@3x PNG assetとして作成する。

conditions: Logo: logo.png, 50–160 pt wide and 50 pt high.
Primary logo: primaryLogo.png, 30–126 pt wide and 30 pt high.
Secondary logo: secondaryLogo.png, 12–135 pt wide and 12 pt high.
Icon: icon.png, 38×38 pt.
Strip image: strip.png, 375×144 pt.
Thumbnail: thumbnail.png, 60–90 pt wide and 90 pt high.
Nonposter background: background.png, 343×503 pt; poster background: artwork.png, 358×448 pt.
Airline boarding-pass footer: footer.png, 268×15 pt.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0051.review_note: Recovered the PNG scale requirement and preserved every structured filename and dimension row as one variant-based asset contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0052.title: Use accessible fields for pass text

statement.en: Use text fields and semantic tags instead of images for textual pass information.
statement.ja: textual pass informationにはimageではなくtext fieldとsemantic tagを使う。

conditions: Embedded image text isn't accessible and images may not appear on every device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0052.review_note: Recovered the explicit accessible alternative as a separate MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0053.title: Use Wallet tooling for pass barcodes

statement.en: Use Pass Designer or corresponding APIs to add barcodes instead of embedding them in pass images.
statement.ja: barcodeはpass imageへ埋め込まずPass Designerまたは対応APIで追加する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0053.review_note: Recovered the required machine-readable-content path as a Wallet format contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0054.title: Keep strip-image text areas legible

statement.en: Keep the areas behind strip-image text uncluttered.
statement.ja: strip imageのtext背面領域をunclutteredに保つ。

conditions: Place important visual elements toward the bottom or trailing edge.
Avoid embedding text in the strip image.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0054.review_note: Recovered strip-image composition guidance while leaving it below mandatory contrast.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0055.title: Use the documented Wallet thumbnail asset

statement.en: Export Wallet pass thumbnails as transparent PNGs with rounded artwork corners.
statement.ja: Wallet pass thumbnailをrounded artwork corner付きtransparent PNGとしてexportする。

conditions: Use thumbnail.png at 60–90 pt wide and 90 pt high.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0055.review_note: Recovered the thumbnail format and shape as an exact asset contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0056.title: Keep pass background content in the safe area

statement.en: Position Wallet pass background content within the documented safe area.
statement.ja: Wallet pass background contentをdocumented safe area内に配置する。

conditions: Account for the bottom material strip on poster generic and poster event passes.
Account for a barcode when the pass includes one.
Preview placement in Pass Designer.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0056.review_note: Classified the documented safe area as a pass-layout contract and preserved both obstructions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.title: Ensure the displayed order price matches the confirmed price

statement.en: Ensure the price shown in a Wallet order matches the final price the customer confirmed.
statement.ja: Wallet orderに表示するpriceをcustomerが確認したfinal priceと一致させる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure financial-accuracy requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.title: Provide the required merchant contact link

statement.en: Provide at least a link to the merchant's website or landing page in Wallet order contact options.
statement.ja: Wallet orderのcontact optionに少なくともmerchant websiteまたはlanding pageへのlinkを提供する。

conditions: Additional options can include Messages for Business, phone, email, and a support page.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit at-minimum need-to requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0059.title: Provide an available carrier tracking link

statement.en: Provide a carrier tracking link whenever one is available.
statement.ja: carrier tracking linkが利用可能な場合は提供する。

conditions: Apply whether detailed interim carrier statuses are available or only a shipped status can be reported.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.title: Provide a fallback identity-verification method

statement.en: Provide another identity-verification method when Verify with Apple Wallet isn't available.
statement.ja: Verify with Apple Walletを利用できない場合は別のidentity-verification methodを提供する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.review_note: Recovered the availability fallback as a required completion path.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.title: Never request identity verification before the person is ready

statement.en: Never request Wallet identity verification before a person starts the requiring process or while they merely create an account.
statement.ja: 利用者が必要なprocessを開始する前や単にaccountを作成している間はWallet identity verificationを要求しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.review_note: Raised the direct don't instruction to MUST_NOT under privacy and explicit user intent.
